hooks.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && VAULT_CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain .obsidian-ai-memory/ AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md .claude/ .cursor/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && if [ "$VAULT_CHANGED" -gt "0" ]; then echo "[CodeJudgeX] Auto-committing vault changes..."; git add .obsidian-ai-memory/ AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md .claude/ .cursor/ 2>/dev/null; TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'); git commit -m "memory: $TIMESTAMP claude — auto session commit" --no-verify 2>/dev/null && git push origin HEAD 2>/dev/null && echo "[CodeJudgeX] Vault committed and pushed."; else echo "[CodeJudgeX] No vault changes to commit."; fi && echo "
=== CodeJudgeX Shutdown Reminder ===
VAULT: auto-committed above (no consent needed).
CODE (backend/ frontend/ infra/ docs/): needs your explicit commit + consent.
Remember: session digest written? session-continuity.md overwritten?
====================================="
echo "[CodeJudgeX] Pre-edit: session-continuity.md + error-memory.md read this session?"
